trigger_examples.example: 'How much do you charge for SEO?'
'Can we get a quote for a website?'
'How much do you charge for websites?'
'How do I get the SEO audit?'
'Can you help with a marketing plan?'

bot_question_flow.question: What's your main goal right now — more Google traffic, a better website, a mobile app, or overall digital strategy?
options: Not sure — I need a consultation
bot_question_flow.why: This replaces the cleaning quote intake. Boxmark should route to SEO audit, website audit, app strategy, or consultation based on the prospect's goal.

bot_question_flow.question: Do you currently have a website and Google Business Profile active?
bot_question_flow.why: Determines whether the first step should be SEO audit, website audit, GBP/local SEO setup, or full digital foundation.

bot_question_flow.question: Are you trying to improve this now, this quarter, or just exploring options?
bot_question_flow.why: Separates urgent growth or launch needs from low-intent research.

bot_question_flow.question: Are your customers mostly English-speaking, Spanish-speaking, or both?
bot_question_flow.why: Spanish SEO is Boxmark's differentiator. This detects whether the strongest offer should be bilingual SEO.

bot_reply_templates.label: Standard audit / pricing request
bot_reply_templates.trigger: They ask for price, quote, estimate, SEO audit, website audit, or marketing help
bot_reply_templates.comment:
Happy to help — the best first step is a free audit so we can see where your business stands before talking numbers 🔍

Quick question: what's your main goal right now — more Google traffic, a better website, a mobile app, or overall digital strategy?

Once we know that, we'll point you to the right audit or strategy call.
notes: Uses free audit as the primary CTA
Asks only the most important routing question
Keeps the thread consultative instead of salesy

bot_reply_templates.label: When they just say 'how much?' with no context
bot_reply_templates.comment: Depends on the goal — SEO, website, apps and strategy are all different. Start with the free audit here and we'll show you the right next step: https://boxmarkdigital.com/free-seo-audit 🔍
notes: Routes to audit instead of negotiation
Useful when there is not enough context

bot_reply_templates.label: When they signal urgency
bot_reply_templates.trigger: Reply contains 'ASAP', 'urgent', 'launching soon', 'opening soon', 'this week', 'need leads now'
bot_reply_templates.comment: Got it — if you're launching or need leads soon, start with the free audit so we can see the fastest opportunities first 🔍 What's the priority right now: Google traffic, website fixes, or both?
